page.overview:
Who is Melissa?

Melissa is a major character from Room for One More, the second story in Fazbear Frights 3: 1:35AM She's Stanley's older sister who tries her best to support him after his girlfriend breaks up with him.

Melissa has curly brown hair that she pulls back into a neat ponytail. She wears button-down shirts and khakis to work.

Melissa is a very responsible person, always being organized and planning ahead. She has a tendency to make others follow her organized schedule, which can make her seem bossy and annoying. Melissa cares for Stanley and can be stubborn when it comes to making sure he’s okay and taking care of himself.
